description: Baseline before any self-upgrade change: master @ 0652a78 (hostname fix, held-out leak fix, CI floor 0.91). CPU only; GPU present but unused (no torch/cupy installed).

Candidate: en_core_web_lg instead of en_core_web_sm as the spaCy detector (branch exp01-spacy-lg @ 4608805). REJECTED at the benchmark gate, so no case rescan: accepted-only P 0.9606->0.9589, single_token recall 0.9606->0.9310 (-3.0pp, over the 0.02 limit), F1 0.9362->0.9327, 2 tests fail (first-name propagation: lg's different span boundaries leave 'Kenji' of 'Dr. Kenji Ito' unaccepted). Only gain: benchmark_unseen recall 0.9655->1.000 (+1 of 29 mentions, noise). Timing +5% (1.80 vs 1.72 s; an earlier 9.8 s reading was machine-state noise, re-timed alternating with sm).

Candidate (branch exp02-bare-common-surname @ 27f0ced): an ACCEPTED single word that is an ordinary English word known only as a surname, with a dictionary hit as its only evidence and no accepted full name in the document starting/ending with it, moves to REVIEW. Gate: tests pass, dump005 0 FP, unseen P 1.000, no shape recall drop >0.02, speed flat. TRADE: benchmark accepted-only P 0.9606->0.9710 (+1.04pp), R 0.9131->0.9026 (-1.05pp, all one synthetic code-name alias), F1 flat; accepted+review unchanged. Real case: 8 names ACCEPTED->REVIEW (7 ordinary-word noise, 1 citation surname), nothing newly accepted or lost.

v1 (commit 18d5690): DictionaryDetector tokens must have no letter/digit/underscore before or after. Benchmark P 0.9710->0.9781, R unchanged. Real-case rescan vs exp02: 'Handler' 146 accepted -> 4 in review, 5 accepted names removed - 4 were fragments (Max from '..._Max', Bijoy_Keyboard app, Olaf2Bg log token, a 'comDana' fragment while 'Dana Doe' stayed accepted) but 1 was a real cited author ('1Berger, A.'), lost because a digit before the name was blocked. Revised to v2.

v2 (commit 661dd0e): DictionaryDetector tokens need no letter/underscore before and no letter/digit/underscore after (a digit before is allowed: '1Berger, A.'). Benchmark vs exp02: accepted-only P 0.9710->0.9781, R unchanged, every shape unchanged, dump005 0 FP, unseen P 1.000, speed flat (1.71 s, 31 ms). Real case vs exp02: nothing newly accepted; 'Handler' 146 accepted -> 4 standalone mentions in review; 4 accepted fragments removed (Bijoy_Keyboard app, ..._Max, Olaf2Bg, 'comDana' while 'Dana Doe' stays accepted); 45 REVIEW entries removed, 43 of them only ever glued inside longer tokens, 1 network label ('Aircel North'), 1 not found. Scan 939 s (after a restart; not claimed as a speed-up).

Short day/month names from es/pt/it/sv datepicker arrays added as calendar words (behavior changes only for dom, mie, mån, ott, tor); night, baby, beauty, fish, dip, era, mini, pan, karma, asin added to the first-name/common-word collision list. Benchmark identical to exp03 v2 (no such words in it). Real case vs exp03 v2: exactly 5 accepted names removed, all noise - Dom and Ott (datepicker arrays), Tor (the anonymity network in a VPN app menu), Night and Mie (tiny OCR fragments: 11-, 3- and 42-char files); nothing else changed.

Candidate (branch exp05-spacy-split-at-digits @ be13c62): SpacyDetector splits a PERSON entity at digit-bearing tokens as well as line breaks. Benchmark: overlap metrics identical to exp04; exact boundaries 1154 -> 1156 of 1205 accepted gold hits (both 'Farhan Vora', previously truncated to 'Farhan'); FP unchanged (27). Real case vs exp04: +1 accepted ('Rahul Doe', a name next to an ID number - previously swallowed the same way), +7 REVIEW entries, all noise (a journal abbreviation, a group name, a review fragment, an OCR scrap, a language name, a place name, a browser metric) that a digit-bearing spaCy span had been dragging into rejection. TRADE: 1 real accept recovered vs +2.3% REVIEW noise; accepted precision unaffected.
